# dsh-git-bar
English | 简体中文

A DeepSeek Harness bundle that adds one ambient row above the composer showing
the Session's git con

pSeek Harness bundle that adds one ambient row above the composer showing
the Session's git context:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

- repository name and root
- the branch the Session runs on, or `游离 HEAD` / `detached HEAD` when the

HEAD
is not on a branch
- working-tree change totals (staged / unstaged / untracked in the tooltip)

- ahead/behind counts against the upstream branch
- short commit id — clickable, opening that commi

t on the origin remote
(GitHub, GitLab and Bitbucket commit routes are all handled) — and a
`链接工作树`

/ `linked worktree` marker when the directory is a linked
`git worktree`, or a `N 个工作树` marker when

the repository has more than one
- every label is plain text: select it and copy it

The row refreshes every 8 seconds, on window focus, and when the Session
changes. Reading it never t

ouches the repository; two interactions deliberately
do:

- **click the branch** — a searchable popover lists every local branch with its
upstream, ahead/behi

nd and dirty state, marks the current one, and can check one
out or create a new branch from the cur

改动` tab: the changed files, and the unified diff of the file you
pick, untracked files included (dif

fed against `/dev/null`);
- **click the worktree marker** — lists every worktree of the repository w

ith its
branch and change count. `在此新建会话` opens a new Session in that worktree's
directory — registe

ring the directory as a workspace first when it is not one
yet — (a worktree is a directory, so a Se

ssion is never moved between them),
[该节后续省略]

Requires **DSH >= 0.2.1-rc.2** and `git` on the Host's PATH. The plugin is
distributed through GitHu
b; an npm account is not required.
For the desktop app, use its own Plugin Manager's install/add entry and supply:

Alternatively, search for **dsh-git-bar** in the community `dshmarket` plugin.
The desktop app does
not necessarily use a CLI profile named `web` or `desktop`.
For a regular `dsh web` instance (replace `web` if you use another profile):
[代码示例省略，未执行]
For local development:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The Host half loads at startup, so restart the app after the first install; the
Client half is serve
d on the next page load.
## Publish

Market index (add under **插件 → 发现 → 添加索引源**):
<https://mjnhmd.github.io/dsh-git-bar/market/index.jso

rket index (add under **插件 → 发现 → 添加索引源**):
<https://mjnhmd.github.io/dsh-git-bar/market/index.json>

DSH ships no index of its own: a plugin market is a JSON file (format 1) you host
yourself and add u

nder **插件 → 发现 → 添加索引源**. `docs/market-index.example.json`
is a ready template, `scripts/validate-in

dex.mjs` checks it against DSH's own
validator, and docs/PUBLISH.zh.md walks through pushing the
rep
ository, publishing to npm, and publishing the index.

Community listing: <https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/p/mjnhmd/dsh-git-bar/>.
This is separate from the
self-hosted index above.
### Marketplace screenshots

The root screenshots.json declares the three preview images
in display order, using paths relative t

o that file. The community directory's
next nightly build picks up the manifest after it is pushed;

changing a local
file or embedding images in the README alone does not update the listing card.

All previews use fictional data rendered from `scripts/previews/`. Do not replace
them with screensh
ots containing real workspace, session or private project data.
## Host API
`GET /dsh-git-bar/info?sessionId=<id>[&dir=<absolute path>]`

- admitted through the harness browser session (`ctx.connection.requestRejection`),
so it is unreach

able without the GUI's own credentials;
- the directory comes from the Session store first; `dir` is

repository: null | { root, name, branch, detached, sha,
commitUrl, remote, dirty: { changed, staged

mitUrl` is derived from the `origin` remote: the scp, `ssh://`, `git://`
and http(s) forms all norma

lize to `https://host/owner/repo`, and the commit
route follows the host (GitHub `/commit/`, GitLab

`/-/commit/`, Bitbucket
`/commits/`). A local-path remote yields `null` and the id stays plain text.

`GET /dsh-git-bar/branches?sessionId=<id>` — `{ branches: [{ name, current,
upstream, ahead, behind,

subject, checkedOutIn }], remotes: [{ name, remote,
branch }], remotesTruncated, dirty }`, where `c

heckedOutIn` is the worktree path
holding that branch (a branch can only be checked out in one workt

ree at a time).
`remotes` is the list behind the history branch filter — `<remote>/<branch>`
names t

hat `/log?branch=` accepts as a revision — capped at 500 entries with
`remotesTruncated` set when mo
re exist; `branches` is what the switcher offers.

`GET /dsh-git-bar/worktrees?sessionId=<id>` — `{ root, worktrees: [{ path, name,
branch, detached, s

ha, bare, locked, prunable, main, current, dirty }] }`, each
worktree costing one `status` call for
its own change count.

`POST /dsh-git-bar/branches/checkout` `{ sessionId, branch }` — `{ branch,
created: false }`; 409 wh
en git refuses (local changes, unknown branch).

`POST /dsh-git-bar/branches/create` `{ sessionId, name, from? }` — `{ branch,
created: true }`; the
name is validated with `git check-ref-format --branch`.

`GET /dsh-git-bar/changes?sessionId=<id>` — `{ files: [{ path, status, staged,
additions, deletions
}], dirty, truncated }`, capped at 500 files.
[该节后续省略]
